name: dock-motion
title: Dock (Motion)
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A macOS-style dock where icons magnify as the pointer approaches. Use it for app launchers and playful navigation bars.
docs: Motion build of `dock` — same props, markup and install path; install one or the other. Named exports: Dock, DockItem. `items` take { id, label, icon, onClick?, isActive?, badge? }. `magnification` sets peak scale and `distance` the falloff radius. Pointer-driven — on touch devices it degrades to a plain icon row.
